title: How to create a new chart by using a chart template

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines
location.section: How to create a new chart by using a chart template

slide_intent: Use a chart template as a starting structure so attention can go to the data’s message.
strategic_value: Shared templates with selective labels can keep Helsinki data displays consistent and intelligible.
demonstration: Expanded webpage section: three numbered steps sit above an annotated Excel template chooser; a paragraph discusses optional chart elements.
practical_value: Choose a template from All Charts, then remove redundant legends or add necessary units and labels.

content_islands.name: Template selection
content_islands.spec: The steps and screenshot locate the Templates option.

content_islands.name: Contextual edits
content_islands.spec: Lower text explains when legends may be removed and labels added.

reference_purposes.Application: The source shows selecting cells, opening Recommended Charts and choosing a template, then adapting legends and labels.
